name: Melody ~Koi no Messenger Girl~
original_name: Ｍｅｌｏｄｙ ～恋のメッセンジャーガール～
source:
One evening girl "Melody" came in a dream of a hero. She said that there is a girl who thinks only about him all the time and in order to show her heart Melody will develop mysterious world in reality and in his dreams. Will her feelings be able to reach his heart?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，女孩“美乐蒂”带着英雄的梦想而来。她说有一个女孩一直只想着他，为了表达她的心，Melody将在现实和梦中展开神秘的世界。她的感情能走进他的心吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
